items.title: Pierre Boussaguet interviewed by Matthieu Jaffre, Aix en Provence, France, July 28, 2020
items.q: I play electric bass with two guys in my life: Lalo Schifrin or Michel Legrand.

ctx.x: The feeling, the emotion, yeah, the tone he’s using is very deep. You worked also with people working for soundtracks on movies and films like Michel Legrand — I’d like you to tell a few words about Michel. How was your experience working with such a great composer?

Amazing. And actually I’m trying not to explain but I’m trying to, like everybody things is happening in their life, and personally, just for myself, I’m trying to understand, to put some sense on it — not necessary to explain do we have the explanation of life? It’s a big gamble. But I started first of all because of Ray Brown I started to work with this amazing composer, arranger, orchestrator person, Lalo Schifrin.
